summary: The rise of Microsoft's market value has put it on track to surpass $4 trillion for the first time. The company briefly traded above that level in July and August and first achieved it in January 2024. Both companies are set to report their quarterly earnings later this month.

title: Microsoft Needs to Open Up More About Its OpenAI Dealings

title: Microsoft sued for allegedly misleading millions of Australians with its AI pricing
summary: Microsoft has been sued by the Australian Competition and Consumer Commission (ACCC) for misleading millions of Australians about its office suite pricing increase. The ACCC alleges that the tech giant failed to disclose a third option of paying the same lower price and opting out of the AI, Copilot, in Microsoft 365 plans. This option was only revealed when subscribers began cancelling their subscription. The annual subscription price for the Microsoft 365 personal plan increased by 45% from $109 to $159 with Copilot included. The maximum penalty would be $50m.
reason: The lawsuit could significantly harm Microsoft's reputation and stock performance.
